name: sgs/card-grid
title: SGS Card Grid
description: Flexible image and content grid with overlay and card variants.

sgs._comment_mediaElements: Rule 37-media-no-handroll fix. Card-image object-fit now routes through the shared media-element atom layer instead of a style.css literal. NOT a new client control: prefix 'sgs' resolves (sgs_media_element_attr) to the SAME 'sgsObjectFit' attribute the legacy universal image-controls extension (imageControls/imageControlsExplicit above) already injects and already exposes an 'Object Fit' dropdown for in the inspector -- adding a second ObjectFitField here would give the client two controls for one property. render.php reads that existing value through SGS_Media_Element::style() and marks each card's /

grid.label: Grid
grid._layer_note: This element is BOTH the block root and the grid definition. layer_detect.py's MF-3 guard makes the root OUTER regardless of its own display:grid, so OUTER is correct here — the layout cluster carries the grid/arrangement properties, disambiguated by this element being the grid.
grid._note_animation: FR-35-6 — the scroll-reveal preset (sgsAnimation/sgsAnimationDuration/sgsAnimationEasing) + per-card staggerDelay resolve via explicit attrMap (no `prefix` declared, per ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1). anim:parallax/anim:trigger are honest gaps — this block has no bgParallax/scroll-trigger attributes.

item.label: Card
item._note: Renamed from 'card-tile' 2026-08-15 (element-manifest drift fix) — the real rendered class is `.sgs-card-grid__item` (render.php:694), not `.sgs-card-grid__card-tile`. `textColourHover` (not in this element's attrMap) already resolved to css_element='item' via the markup-fallback derivation before this rename — the key now matches every attr's real target, not just the attrMap-covered ones. Spec 35 FR-35-5 fix (2026-07-21, Task 4) — the card tile now has RESTING-STATE attrs (cardBackground/cardBorderColour/cardBorderWidth/cardRadius/cardShadow) alongside the existing hover-only ones, so backgroundColourHover/borderColourHover/shadowHover are STATE_OK not STATE_WITHOUT_BASE. An empty resting attr means the card inherits the theme token exactly as before (Bean's Option A — custom-property FALLBACK at style.css, never a baked default). The top-level `attrMap` on this element (not `clusters`) is deliberate: it resolves the 5 members for the states-axis base check without declaring the full fill/layout clusters, which would flood this repeater-item element with unrelated GAP findings (padding/width/aspect-ratio/etc. it genuinely doesn't have controls for).

image.label: Card image
image._note: Split from 'card-media' 2026-08-15 (element-manifest drift fix) — imageZoomHover/grayscaleHover resolve to css_element='image' via the cross-block classification override (scripts/attr-classification-overrides.json), the SAME vocabulary token already declared by sgs/gallery, sgs/post-grid and sgs/team-member for this identical hover-effect pattern. This element now names the actual ``/`

image-wrap.label: Image wrapper
image-wrap._note: Split from 'card-media' 2026-08-15 — the wrapping `<div class="sgs-card-grid__image-wrap">` (render.php:695) that sets aspect-ratio via the `--sgs-card-grid-aspect` custom property (aspectRatio attr; markup-fallback derivation already resolves it to css_element='image-wrap'). Mirrors sgs/gallery's own 'img-wrap' element (same split, same reasoning). `prefix: ""` opts this element out of orphan-candidate scanning — it has no other style attrs to claim, so any gap is reported honestly rather than force-claimed.

title.label: Card title
title._note: Renamed from 'card-title' 2026-08-15 (element-manifest drift fix) — real rendered class is `.sgs-card-grid__title` (render.php:702,713), not `.sgs-card-grid__card-title`. `attrMap.tag` added (D-pending, E12 scoping fix) — `headingLevel` sets the rendered tag on this element (render.php:759, `.sgs-card-grid__title`) but doesn't match the `title` prefix convention, so it needs an explicit map for check-hardcoded-render-defaults.js's E12 gate to resolve it to THIS element. `titleColourGradient` (2026-09-03) is the text-colour gradient sibling to titleColour, same background-clip:text mechanism as sgs/counter's numberColourGradient. `states.hover.attrMap` added 2026-09-03 — without it titleColourHover's css_property resolved via CSS-scan with no state signal, tripping check-hover-state-classification.py.

subtitle.label: Card subtitle
subtitle._note: Renamed from 'card-subtitle' 2026-08-15 (element-manifest drift fix) — real rendered class is `.sgs-card-grid__subtitle` (render.php:705,716), not `.sgs-card-grid__card-subtitle`. `subtitleColourGradient` (2026-09-03) is the text-colour gradient sibling to subtitleColour, same background-clip:text mechanism. `states.hover.attrMap` added 2026-09-03 — without it subtitleColourHover's css_property resolved via CSS-scan with no state signal, tripping check-hover-state-classification.py.

badge.label: Card badge
badge._note: Renamed from 'card-badge' 2026-08-15 (element-manifest drift fix) — real rendered class is `.sgs-card-grid__badge` (render.php:719), not `.sgs-card-grid__card-badge`. Per-item badge text + badgeVariant preset are content/variant fields, not exposed as independent style controls — no badge-specific text/fill/layout attrs exist on the block.

attributes._comment_items_media: Migrated 2026-05-05 â€” each item gains a unified `media` slot (image OR video). Legacy `image` retained on items for deprecation back-compat. New instances should write `media` via MediaPicker.

media._note: TWO shapes are accepted and both render. edit.js writes the OBJECT form { url, type, alt, ... } consumed by sgs_render_media(); a BARE URL STRING (what this declared type describes, and what the mega starter patterns use) is normalised to that object in render.php. Before 2026-07-29 the string form silently rendered NOTHING — sgs_render_media() bails on a non-array (helpers-media.php:168) — which cost both mega starter patterns all 8 card images through a green build. Do not 'tidy' the string branch away.

decorative.description: When true, this card image is purely decorative — rendered with an empty alt attribute and aria-hidden on its wrapper so screen readers skip it (WCAG 2.1 AA 1.1.1). Manual/query modes only; wc-product/cpt-collection cards pull an informative product photo the client does not author.

_key._note: Client-generated stable identity (src/utils/generateItemKey.js), not a client-visible field — no label, no editor control. Scopes this item's own object-fit/focal-point CSS so a crop value survives reorder/add/remove instead of following array index (Spec 35 Part 4). Backfilled silently on mount for items created before this field existed.

gap._comment: Was the bare number "30", which the old flat path read as WordPress spacing-scale SLUG 30 = 1rem (theme.json settings.spacing.spacingSizes). A bare number now means px (Bean-ruled 2026-08-10), so the value is stated explicitly to render EXACTLY as before rather than jumping to 30px.

cardBorderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the card border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over cardBorderColour at render time (D636).

borderColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state sibling of cardBorderColourGradient. Non-empty wins over borderColourHover on :hover.

source.description: Where cards come from. 'wc-product' requires WooCommerce; 'cpt-collection' is the WooCommerce-INDEPENDENT path folded in from sgs/content-collection (2026-08-01) — it queries a custom post type (sgs_product by default) with the seven meta-driven selection rules and renders each result through sgs/product-card in sgs-cpt mode.

attributes._comment_cpt_collection: ── Attributes below ported verbatim (same names, same defaults) from sgs/content-collection when that block was folded into this one on 2026-08-01. Names were kept IDENTICAL so migrating an existing sgs/content-collection block is a near-identity attribute map plus source:'cpt-collection'. They are declared here because WordPress silently DISCARDS any attribute a block.json does not declare (D338) — an undeclared port would look correct in render.php and do nothing. Engine: includes/class-cpt-collection-query.php.

contentType.description: Post type queried in cpt-collection mode. Whitelisted server-side; extend via the sgs_content_collection_post_types filter.

selectionRule.description: cpt-collection mode only. The seven meta-driven selection rules. Mirrors CPT_Collection_Query::SELECTION_RULES.

count.description: cpt-collection mode only. Items per page (1–24, capped server-side).

handpickedIds.description: cpt-collection mode, selectionRule 'handpicked'. Explicit post IDs; the operator's order is preserved.

categoryTerm.description: cpt-collection mode, selectionRule 'category'. Term ID in the {contentType}_cat taxonomy.

emptyMessage.default: No items to show yet. Check back soon.
emptyMessage.description: cpt-collection mode empty state (FR-24-6). Never renders blank.

showPickers.description: Forwarded to each rendered product-card in cpt-collection mode. When false, suppresses in-card option-picker UI (axis and pill pickers).

ctaBehaviour.description: Forwarded to each rendered product-card in cpt-collection mode. learn-more = link to the product page; add-to-basket = SGS cart proxy; buy-now = add then redirect to checkout.

showLadder.description: Forwarded to each rendered product-card in cpt-collection mode. Browsing grids default false (price + per-unit note only, no multi-row value ladder).

pagination.description: cpt-collection mode only. Rendered by the shared includes/class-grid-pagination.php helper in MODE_LINK — real <a href> links, so it works without JavaScript and is crawlable. This block has no view.js, so 'load-more' and 'infinite' degrade to numbered links rather than emitting controls nothing would hydrate.

productSource.description: How products are selected: 'collection' = smart preset + filters; 'handpick' = explicit IDs.

productCollection.description: Smart collection preset. Ignored when productSource = 'handpick'.

productCategories.description: WC product category term IDs to filter by (multi-select). Empty = all categories.

productTags.description: WC product tag term IDs to filter by (multi-select). Empty = all tags.

productFeatured.description: When true, only featured products are returned.

productOnSale.description: When true, only on-sale products are returned (uses wc_get_product_ids_on_sale index).

productInStock.description: When true, only in-stock products are returned.

productLimit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1â€“24). Server-side cap enforced at 24. The on-sale filter over-fetches and refills to this limit; fewer are returned only when fewer on-sale products exist.

productIds.description: Explicit product IDs for handpick mode. Order is respected.

productShowLadder.description: Show the per-pack price ladder on each card. Off by default â€” grids are a browsing context; the ladder does its upsell work on the product page.

productEmptyMessage.default: No products to show at the moment. Check back soon.
productEmptyMessage.description: Message shown when the product query returns zero results (FR-24-6 empty state).

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
